value.rationale: Source explicitly isolates the square-index support at modulus four and studies a self-convolution modulo eight, leaving individual modulo-eight behavior unsettled. The exact all-index formula proves sharp square support at modulus eight, classifies both other even residues and demonstrates failure at 16 using n=36. This is a natural first two-adic boundary for that arithmetic partition statistic, not an arbitrary finite slice or recomputation of existing numerical table.
